quote: LETON Power builds on group and brand history dating to 2001. We design and supply industrial diesel generator sets for critical power projects, with R&D in Chengdu and equipment production in Ningde and Weifang. We can export equipment to more than 160 countries and regions.
Leton Power delivers robust generator sets adaptable to Gas, HFO, Turbine, and Diesel
